findings.description: check_regression only compares sim_time metric for degradation. Other baseline metrics (object positions) are stored but never checked. Consider iterating numeric metrics or documenting this limitation.
test_default_config doesn't exercise the true default-fallback path where config_path is None and no config file exists. The _DEFAULT_CONFIG return path is untested.

summary: Phase 8 implementation is clean and complete. All 233 tests pass, no ROS imports in forge_core/, valid YAML/JSON throughout, correct cross-references, docs are accurate. Two minor info-level findings (sim_time-only metric comparison, one untested config fallback path) — neither blocking.
